cases.input: A business unit purchases 500 SaaS seats and uses the application without a local installation.
cases.expect: The entitlement and application usage are valid while local installation remains explicitly absent.

cases.input: Fifty seats move from one business unit to another within the same effective entitlement.
cases.expect: Successor allocation records preserve history without changing product or application identity.

cases.input: An annual entitlement is renewed with a higher quantity and a successor term.
cases.expect: A successor entitlement period or revision is linked; the expired period remains resolvable.

cases.input: A purchase order automatically creates an installation and active deployment.
cases.expect: The inference is rejected because commercial authorization and technical deployment are separate lifecycles.

cases.input: Six hundred seats are allocated from a 500-seat entitlement.
cases.expect: The allocation is rejected or held as non-compliant; entitlement quantity is not silently expanded.

cases.input: An expired licence remains active because the application is still running.
cases.expect: Effective entitlement is expired; observed running state does not extend the commercial term.

cases.input: Upgrade rights cause the old licensed product scope to be overwritten with a new release.
cases.expect: The rewrite is rejected; historical scope remains intact and upgrade eligibility is recorded separately.
